cards.name: Cross Process (RGB)
cards.summary: A retro cross-processed look: shadows go olive-brown and highlights go yellow-green (wall about 201, 196, 83 against 179, 149, 93; dark area about 40, 32, 11), colours turn punchy and the contrast spread rises to 64 (mean brightness 110).
